verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi yaṁ evaṁ lahuparivattaṁ yathayidaṁ cittaṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that’s as quick to change as the mind.

verses.pali: Yāvañcidaṁ, bhikkhave, upamāpi na sukarā yāva lahuparivattaṁ cittan”ti.
verses.english: So much so that it’s not easy to give a simile for how quickly the mind changes.”
